start: A v* tag release run whose publish job succeeded

steps.action: release-apk.yml calls 'Play upload (testing tracks)' with the tag, dry_run false
must_not: A start before the release's publish job succeeded

steps.action: The tag's own apps/mobile/src/lib/whatsNew.ts is read
user_sees: Its byte count in the log
must_not: What's new notes from main instead of the tag

steps.action: mettleup-<tag>.aab is downloaded from the release
user_sees: The AAB listed in the log
must_not: A rebuilt AAB uploaded instead of the gated, signed release asset

user_sees: The phone build on internal, alpha and beta with the What's new notes

steps.action: 'Upload the watch app to Play (Wear OS internal + closed + open testing)'
user_sees: The watch build on wear:internal, wear:closed, wear:beta
must_not: A watch failure undoing the phone tracks
A watch failure hidden (it must turn the job red)

start: A release made before 0.60.0 (no watch bundle)

steps.action: The watch step looks for mettleup-<tag>-wear.aab
user_sees: '::notice::<tag> has no mettleup-<tag>-wear.aab (watch bundles start with 0.60.0): nothing to upload for the watch.'
must_not: A failed GitHub call read as 'no watch bundle'

start: A bad tag or a production track

steps.action: The tag is not like v0.57.0
user_sees: '::error::'<tag>' is not a release tag like v0.57.0.'

steps.action: Open testing is not set up on Play
user_sees: A warning; internal and closed still go out
must_not: The whole upload failing for the open track

start: The same tag uploaded a second time

steps.action: The release run is re-run for the same tag
user_sees: Each track that already has the versionCode skipped with a log line
must_not: A second release on a track
A versionCode error turning the job red

start: GitHub Actions page, workflow 'Play upload (testing tracks)'

steps.action: Press 'Run workflow', type tag v0.57.1, leave dry run on
must_not: Dry run off by default on a hand start

steps.action: The run validates the phone and watch edits on Play
user_sees: Play validated the edit; nothing committed
must_not: A testing track changed by a dry run

start: Hand start with a wrong tag

user_sees: '::error::'0.57.1' is not a release tag like v0.57.0.'

steps.action: Type a tag with no release asset
must_not: A rebuild started in its place

start: Hand start with dry run off, then again

user_sees: Tracks internal, alpha, beta and the watch tracks get the release

steps.action: Run it again for the same tag
user_sees: Every track skipped: it already has that versionCode
must_not: A second release on any track
